snippet.title: I Made My First Horror VISUAL NOVEL.
snippet.description:
R E A D   M E ─────── · · ♡

Hey, Channie here! I'm the artist, VA, and developer of Xenia Is Online. I've been working on this for a few weeks and noticed some... strange things going on.

Full game is now available on itch.io!
─ https://channiepenghua.itch.io/xenia-is-online

· · ─────── · ♰ · ─────── · ·

Video editing and art are all my own.
